title: Woman Kidnaps Ex’s Child For Revenge
description:
This was no joke, and there would be consequences for the woman’s ex. She was even using the child as a means to reconcile with the mother and would most likely face felony charges. Her ex-girlfriend seemed intent on hurting her, regardless of what the child sitting in the car was experiencing. For her, it was more of a revenge plot. Listen carefully to what the mother says. The officers reviewed the CCTV footage from cameras pointing toward the bar's parking lot where the woman was. The footage they found would serve as key evidence in the case. The woman was finally able to get her ex on the phone, which helped the officers locate her vehicle—surprisingly, it was not where they had initially thought. The police issued a felony alert on the suspect’s car, and it was soon located in the parking lot of a laundromat. There was another female with the mother’s ex but she only knew that both of them had gotten into an argument earlier. She along with the ex were taken to the police station for further investigation. The woman was charged with kidnapping and she was held at a correctional center waiting for her bond to be prepared.
